question: Should ClawSegmentedControl define balanced wrapping as the shared Android behavior for every option set larger than four, or should wrapping remain local to Skill Workshop?
rationale: Both implementations can fix the demonstrated truncation, but only the Android owner can establish whether this layout policy belongs in the reusable design-system component.

options.title: Adopt shared wrapping
options.body: Approve the proposed at-most-four-per-row balanced layout as the reusable component contract and refresh the branch for merge.

options.title: Keep wrapping local
options.body: Preserve the existing shared single-row contract and apply a Skill Workshop-specific multi-row composition instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared wrapping
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed at-most-four-per-row balanced layout as the reusable component contract and refresh the branch for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository’s Android README explicitly identifies this account as the Android app owner, and the timeline already routes the PR to them.
